test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
8 boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Two boys are sitting on each side. D is second to the right of A. H and D sit on the opposite sides. H is either third to the left of D or third to the right of D. A and B are sitting on the same side. E is not the neighbour of H or D. F is not the neighbour of E and H.

Who are the neighbours of E?
solution:
Eight Boys: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H;

i) Two boys are sitting on each side. 

ii) D is second to the right of A. 

iii) H and D sit on the opposite sides. 

iv) H is either third to the left of D or third to the right of D. 

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adc58a2109103b8809611168d9dcada2ce7b401f58c89478f79712a5116b860e.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c045679f29267d134c4d7603d868c8ac78d4092f0ce20c3ed4c4906e375f8d9e.png] 

v) A and B are sitting on the same side. 

vi) E is not the neighbour of H or D. 

This eliminates Case 2.

vii) F is not the neighbour of E and H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90d46dfc6955f2c78c02a7ebafe0d082c2975302ec0bc5d06047ff96edbb1a39.png] 

Here, C and G are neighbours of E.

Hence, C and G is the correct answer.
